newsitem.title: POLAND: BZW to advise Polish PZU on share placement.
newsitem.headline: BZW to advise Polish PZU on share placement.

text.p: Poland's largest insurance firm Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen SA mandated Barclays de Zoete Wedd Ltd (BZW) as adviser on its private placement planned for next month, PZU's spokesman said on Thursday.
Marek Maszek told Reuters BZW would choose foreign or domestic institutions and negotiate with them the placement of between 250 and 750 million zlotys worth of PZU new shares.
"BZW became our investment adviser, we have already signed an agreement," he said.
The issue would give the investors up to 50 percent of PZU, now fully state-owned. Under the plan, each of the investors will have no more than 10-15 percent of the shares.

Earlier PZU has said it was interested in attracting leading Polish and foreign financial institutions and such international institutions as the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and the International Finance Corporation (IFC).
Maszek also said PZU expected to raise at least 500 million zlotys through the new issue.
"The 500 million zlotys is what we need in the beginning," he said.
The next stage of PZU's privatisation was expected early next year with the company's bourse listing either in Warsaw or in London.
According to unaudited results, PZU had a net loss of 90 million zlotys on 3.5-billion-zloty gross premiums last year, but hoped to record profit this year.
